# AZAFCO International - Fresh Fish Processing and Export (Egypt)

> Egyptian B2B company that processes, packs and exports fresh fish for importers, wholesalers and distributors.

## Company Information
- Name: AZAFCO International (ازافكو العالمية)
- Legal name: AZAFCO International for Investment and Development S.A.E.
- Arabic legal name: ازافكو العالمية للاستثمار والتنمية (ش.م.م)
- Legal form: Egyptian joint-stock company (S.A.E., شركة مساهمة مصرية) under Law 159/1981
- Commercial Register: No. 100776
- Industry: Fresh fish processing, packing and export (B2B)
- Founded: 2008
- Location: Industrial Zone, Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
- Website: https://azafco.com.eg (Arabic: /ar, English: /en)
- Contact: +201007736419, business@azafco.com.eg

## What We Do
AZAFCO supplies fresh fish from Egypt to B2B buyers: importers, wholesalers, distributors and hospitality purchasing teams. B2B only (no retail). Specifications, packing, volumes, prices and shipping terms are confirmed per quote.

## Products
1. Tilapia (بلطي) - Oreochromis niloticus - Freshwater
2. Sea Bass (قاروص) - Dicentrarchus labrax - Marine
3. Grey Mullet (بوري) - Mugil cephalus - Brackish water
4. Grass Carp (حشايش) - Ctenopharyngodon idella - Freshwater
5. Common Carp (قشرة) - Cyprinus carpio - Freshwater
6. Catfish (قراميط) - Clarias gariepinus - Freshwater
7. Meagre (لوت) - Argyrosomus regius - Marine
8. Thinlip Mullet (طوبار) - Chelon ramada - Brackish water
9. Bayad Catfish (بياض) - Bagrus bajad - Freshwater
10. Silver Carp (سلفر) - Hypophthalmichthys molitrix - Freshwater
11. Mirror Carp (مبروكة) - Cyprinus carpio (mirror variety) - Freshwater
12. Sea Bream (دنيس) - Sparus aurata - Marine
Sizes, grades and availability: confirmed per order with the export team.

## Export Markets
- Active: Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Iraq, Syria, Bahrain, Lebanon
- Paused: Spain
- Planned: Russia, United States
Enquiries from other destinations are reviewed case by case.
